summary: 1Balance sells six herbal tisane and tea blends, each formulated for a different time of day, such as digestion, energy, or sleep. The company offers free shipping over $35, a 30-day money-back guarantee, and online customer support. Accel lists 1Balance as a seed investment made in 2019, with founders Srini Sharma, Karthikeyan Iyer, and Dikshant Dave, and a Bangalore base.
business_model: Subscription-based direct-to-consumer sales of herbal supplements via Shopify
customers: Consumers seeking daily herbal wellness products
